That same control plane relies on replay-key controls manifests and L0 route policy dispatch to keep every agent action traceable. - bul_unify_006: Scaled the platform engineering team from 8 to 28 while converting bespoke delivery into reusable, commercialized AI platform IP and an operating model for agentic AI.
